get.description: Retrieves a list of skills in a department, with pagination support.

parameters.name: searchString
parameters.description: Search string used to filter skills by names that start with this value

parameters.name: skillTypeId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the skill type used to filter skills

parameters.name: skillIds
parameters.description: ID(s) of the skill(s) to list, separated by commas. You can pass up to 50 IDs

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the department

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of skills to fetch. Default is 100

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number from which skills must be fetched

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filters skills by status. Possible values: ACTIVE, INACTIVE
